_comment: Payroll-tax differential on OPT employment. The RATES are statutory and the AUTHORISATION COUNTS are published; the WAGES are assumptions and every derived total is a scenario, not a measurement. No agency publishes OPT wages, which is why no single national figure appears here.
statute: IRC 3121(b)(19); IRS guidance lists practical training as exempt

lca_wage_context.note: H-1B wages at universities, shown only to inform the choice of scenario. Not OPT wages, and not used as a substitute for them.

caveats: The exemption ends when the holder becomes a resident alien for tax purposes, generally after five calendar years in F or J status.
Exempt wages accrue no Social Security credits for the worker.
Authorisations are not full-time-equivalent years of employment, so applying an annual wage to a count overstates a single year.
